projects.description: Multi-agent AI CRM system automating lead scoring, outreach, deal-risk and churn prediction using LLaMA 3.3 via Groq.
AI-powered IT helpdesk (built for Smart India Hackathon) with NLP ticket classification, automated routing, and an AI chatbot — Flask + LLM-powered.
Customer churn prediction system using Logistic Regression and Random Forest, with EDA and feature engineering for retention insights.
Content-based movie recommendation engine using Python, Pandas, and Scikit-learn to suggest films from metadata, genres, and cast.
